NoTarget.label: Add gizmo "No Target" to hostile pawns
NoTarget.description: When toggled on, this prevents colonists and turrets from auto-targeting the pawn. Enemy pawns that have positive relationships with colonists will be automatically marked as "No Target".

CaptureAsJob.label: Add gizmo "Capture" to capturable pawns
CaptureAsJob.description: When toggled on, the pawn will be marked as available for capture. Colonists assigned with warden jobs will capture them automatically.

AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.label: Mark relatives of prisoners from raids as "No Target" automatically
AutoNoTargetForPrisonerRelatives.description: By default, only colonists' relatives are marked as "No Target". When enabled, this setting extends the marking to relatives of prisoners from raids.
